SELECT ch.DSPLY_NM AS channel_name, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN txn
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON txn.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL ch ON txn.CHNL_K = ch.CHNL_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY ch.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY transaction_count DESC;

SELECT jur.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction, COUNT(*) AS aml_alert_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT aml
JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR jur ON aml.JUR_K = jur.JUR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON aml.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY jur.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY aml_alert_count DESC;

SELECT br.BR_K, br.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name, COUNT(atm.ATM_TXN_F_K) AS atm_transaction_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN atm
JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR br ON atm.BR_K = br.BR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON atm.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY br.BR_K, br.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY atm_transaction_count DESC;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS card_disputes_2025
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT dsp
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON dsp.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT d_cc.DSPLY_NM AS complaint_category, COUNT(f_c.CMPLT_F_K) AS complaint_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f_c
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG d_cc ON f_c.CMPLT_CTG_K = d_cc.CMPLT_CTG_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d_dt ON f_c.BUS_DT_K = d_dt.DT_K
WHERE d_dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY d_cc.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY complaint_count DESC;

SELECT d_ccy.ISO_ALPH_CD1 AS currency_code,
       AVG(f_fx_rt_d.AVRG_RT) AS avg_daily_fx_rate
FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D f_fx_rt_d
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d_dt ON f_fx_rt_d.BUS_DT_K = d_dt.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY d_ccy ON f_fx_rt_d.CCY_K = d_ccy.CCY_K
WHERE d_dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY d_ccy.ISO_ALPH_CD1
ORDER BY d_ccy.ISO_ALPH_CD1;

SELECT
  d_dt.CAL_YR_NBR AS year,
  fptf.MKT_ID AS market_id,
  SUM(fptf.MKT_VAL1_AMT) AS total_portfolio_valuation
FROM
  bank_dwh.F_PTF_VAL_D fptf
JOIN
  bank_dwh.D_DT d_dt ON fptf.BUS_DT_K = d_dt.DT_K
WHERE
  d_dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY
  d_dt.CAL_YR_NBR,
  fptf.MKT_ID
ORDER BY
  fptf.MKT_ID;

SELECT ACCT_TYP_CD1 AS account_type_code, COUNT(*) AS accounts_opened_2025
FROM bank_dwh.D_ACCT
WHERE OPND_DT >= '2025-01-01' AND OPND_DT < '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY ACCT_TYP_CD1
ORDER BY ACCT_TYP_CD1;

SELECT br.CTY_NM AS branch_city, COUNT(*) AS atm_transaction_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN txn
JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR br ON txn.BR_K = br.BR_K AND br.IS_CURR = TRUE
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON txn.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND dt.QTR_NBR = 1
GROUP BY br.CTY_NM
ORDER BY br.CTY_NM;

SELECT AVG(f.MID_RT) AS avg_mid_rate_usd_dec_2025
FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY c ON f.CCY_K = c.CCY_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE c.ISO_ALPH_CD1 = 'USD'
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND d.MTH_NBR = 12;

SELECT CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS customer_segment, COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1
ORDER BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1;

WITH txn_2025_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT CUST_K
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN txn
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON txn.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
    WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers_with_no_txn_2025
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST cust
WHERE cust.IS_CURR = TRUE
  AND cust.CUST_K NOT IN (SELECT CUST_K FROM txn_2025_customers);

WITH auth_2025 AS (
    SELECT f.PMT_STS_CD1
    FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH f
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
),
counts AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(*) AS total_auths,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE PMT_STS_CD1 = 'DECLINED') AS declined_auths
    FROM auth_2025
)
SELECT
    CASE WHEN total_auths = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (declined_auths::numeric / total_auths) * 100 END AS declined_percentage
FROM counts;

SELECT chnl.DSPLY_NM AS channel_name,
       SUM(fee.FEE_AMT) AS total_fees_2025
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_FEE fee
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON fee.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST cust ON fee.CUST_K = cust.CUST_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY ccy ON fee.CCY_K = ccy.CCY_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST chnl ON fee.CHNL_K = chnl.CUST_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY chnl.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY chnl.DSPLY_NM;

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(TXN_AMT), 0) AS total_transaction_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT dsp
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON dsp.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dsp.DSPT_RSN_CD1 = 'FRAUD'
  AND dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT jur.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction_name, COUNT(*) AS aml_alert_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT aml
JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR jur ON aml.JUR_K = jur.JUR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON aml.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE aml.ALRT_SVRTY_CD1 = 'HIGH'
  AND dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY jur.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY jur.DSPLY_NM;

WITH target_date AS (
    SELECT DT_K FROM bank_dwh.D_DT WHERE CAL_DT = '2025-08-31'
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT LN_ID) AS loans_over_90_days_past_due
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DSBRS
WHERE DYS_PST_DUE > 90
  AND BUS_DT_K = (SELECT DT_K FROM target_date);

WITH target_date AS (
    SELECT DT_K FROM bank_dwh.D_DT WHERE CAL_DT = '2025-12-31'
),
-- Sum of disbursed principal up to and including target date
sum_disbursed AS (
    SELECT LN_PRD_K, SUM(PRNCP_AMT) AS total_disbursed
    FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DSBRS
    WHERE BUS_DT_K <= (SELECT DT_K FROM target_date)
    GROUP BY LN_PRD_K
),
-- Sum of principal repaid up to and including target date
sum_repaid AS (
    SELECT LN_PRD_K, SUM(PRNCP_PAID_AMT) AS total_repaid
    FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_RPMT
    WHERE BUS_DT_K <= (SELECT DT_K FROM target_date)
    GROUP BY LN_PRD_K
),
outstanding AS (
    SELECT
        d.LN_PRD_K,
        d.DSPLY_NM AS loan_product_name,
        COALESCE(sd.total_disbursed, 0) - COALESCE(sr.total_repaid, 0) AS outstanding_principal
    FROM bank_dwh.D_LN_PRD d
    LEFT JOIN sum_disbursed sd ON d.LN_PRD_K = sd.LN_PRD_K
    LEFT JOIN sum_repaid sr ON d.LN_PRD_K = sr.LN_PRD_K
    WHERE d.IS_CURR = TRUE
)
SELECT loan_product_name, SUM(outstanding_principal) AS total_outstanding_principal
FROM outstanding
GROUP BY loan_product_name
ORDER BY loan_product_name;

WITH atm_txn_2025 AS (
    SELECT
        BR_K,
        COUNT(*) AS atm_txn_count
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    GROUP BY BR_K
),
ranked_branches AS (
    SELECT
        a.BR_K,
        a.atm_txn_count,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY b.RGN_CD1 ORDER BY a.atm_txn_count DESC) AS rn
    FROM atm_txn_2025 a
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR b ON a.BR_K = b.BR_K
    WHERE b.IS_CURR = TRUE
)
SELECT
    b.RGN_CD1 AS region_code,
    b.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name,
    r.atm_txn_count
FROM ranked_branches r
JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR b ON r.BR_K = b.BR_K
WHERE r.rn = 1
ORDER BY b.RGN_CD1;

SELECT
  m.MRCH_CTG_CD1 AS merchant_category_code,
  SUM(f.TXN_AMT) AS total_card_authorization_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_FEE f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_MRCH_CTG m ON f.MRCH_CTG_K = m.MRCH_CTG_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY m.MRCH_CTG_CD1
ORDER BY total_card_authorization_amount DESC
LIMIT 3;

WITH wire_transfers_2025 AS (
    SELECT
        f.CUST_K,
        SUM(COALESCE(f.STLM_AMT, 0)) AS total_wire_amount
    FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    GROUP BY f.CUST_K
)
SELECT
    c.BUS_ID AS customer_business_id,
    w.total_wire_amount
FROM wire_transfers_2025 w
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON w.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
WHERE c.IS_CURR = TRUE
ORDER BY w.total_wire_amount DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT f.CCY_CD1 AS currency_code, SUM(f.STLM_AMT) AS total_wire_transfer_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY f.CCY_CD1
ORDER BY f.CCY_CD1;

WITH atm_customers_2025 AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT CUST_K
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT ON F_ATM_TXN.BUS_DT_K = D_DT.DT_K
    WHERE D_DT.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
),
wr_trf_customers_2025 AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT CUST_K
    FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT ON F_WR_TRF.BUS_DT_K = D_DT.DT_K
    WHERE D_DT.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS distinct_customers_both_txn_2025
FROM (
    SELECT CUST_K FROM atm_customers_2025
    INTERSECT
    SELECT CUST_K FROM wr_trf_customers_2025
) AS both_txn_customers;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_count_2025
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF wr
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON wr.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT d.cal_yr_nbr AS year, COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_count
FROM bank_dwh.f_wr_trf f
JOIN bank_dwh.d_dt d ON f.bus_dt_k = d.dt_k
WHERE d.cal_yr_nbr IN (2024, 2025)
GROUP BY d.cal_yr_nbr
ORDER BY d.cal_yr_nbr;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS bank_dwh.F_CMPLT;

SELECT
  COUNT(CASE WHEN ddt.is_wknd THEN 1 END) AS weekend_count,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN NOT ddt.is_wknd THEN 1 END) AS weekday_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN fatm
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT ddt ON fatm.BUS_DT_K = ddt.DT_K
WHERE ddt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

WITH date_keys AS (
    SELECT
        MAX(CASE WHEN CAL_DT = '2025-06-30' THEN DT_K END) AS dt_k_jun_30,
        MAX(CASE WHEN CAL_DT = '2025-12-31' THEN DT_K END) AS dt_k_dec_31
    FROM bank_dwh.D_DT
),
acct_balances AS (
    SELECT
        ACCT_K,
        BUS_DT_K,
        CLSNG_BAL_AMT
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D
    WHERE BUS_DT_K IN ((SELECT dt_k_jun_30 FROM date_keys), (SELECT dt_k_dec_31 FROM date_keys))
),
bal_pivot AS (
    SELECT
        ACCT_K,
        MAX(CASE WHEN BUS_DT_K = (SELECT dt_k_jun_30 FROM date_keys) THEN CLSNG_BAL_AMT END) AS bal_jun_30,
        MAX(CASE WHEN BUS_DT_K = (SELECT dt_k_dec_31 FROM date_keys) THEN CLSNG_BAL_AMT END) AS bal_dec_31
    FROM acct_balances
    GROUP BY ACCT_K
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS accounts_count
FROM bal_pivot
WHERE bal_jun_30 IS NOT NULL
  AND bal_dec_31 IS NOT NULL
  AND bal_dec_31 < bal_jun_30 * 0.9;

WITH complaint_2025 AS (
    SELECT
        cmplt.CMPLT_CTG_K,
        dt.CAL_YR_NBR,
        cmplt.CNTCT_STRTD_AT,
        cmplt.RSLTN_AT
    FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT cmplt
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON cmplt.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
    WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
      AND cmplt.IS_RSLVD = TRUE
      AND cmplt.CNTCT_STRTD_AT IS NOT NULL
      AND cmplt.RSLTN_AT IS NOT NULL
),
category_avg_days AS (
    SELECT
        cmplt.CMPLT_CTG_K,
        AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (cmplt.RSLTN_AT - cmplt.CNTCT_STRTD_AT)) / 86400.0) AS avg_days_to_resolution
    FROM complaint_2025 cmplt
    GROUP BY cmplt.CMPLT_CTG_K
)
SELECT
    cat.CMPLT_CTG_K,
    cat_avg.avg_days_to_resolution
FROM category_avg_days cat_avg
JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT CMPLT_CTG_K FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT
) cat ON cat.CMPLT_CTG_K = cat_avg.CMPLT_CTG_K
ORDER BY cat.CMPLT_CTG_K;

WITH cust_versions AS (
    SELECT
        CUST_K,
        VRSN_NBR,
        CUST_SGMNT_CD1,
        LEAD(CUST_SGMNT_CD1) OVER (PARTITION BY CUST_K ORDER BY VRSN_NBR DESC) AS next_segment
    FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
    WHERE CUST_SGMNT_CD1 IS NOT NULL
),
changed_segments AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT CUST_K
    FROM cust_versions
    WHERE next_segment IS NOT NULL
      AND CUST_SGMNT_CD1 <> next_segment
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers_with_segment_change
FROM changed_segments;

WITH txn_quarters AS (
    SELECT
        f.CUST_K,
        d.QTR_NBR
    FROM
        bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN f
        JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE
        d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    GROUP BY
        f.CUST_K,
        d.QTR_NBR
),
quarters_2025 AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT QTR_NBR FROM bank_dwh.D_DT WHERE CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
),
cust_quarter_counts AS (
    SELECT
        CUST_K,
        COUNT(DISTINCT QTR_NBR) AS quarters_with_txn
    FROM
        txn_quarters
    GROUP BY
        CUST_K
),
required_quarters_count AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_quarters FROM quarters_2025
)
SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS distinct_customers
FROM
    cust_quarter_counts cqc,
    required_quarters_count rqc
WHERE
    cqc.quarters_with_txn = rqc.total_quarters;

WITH DisputingCustomers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT fcd.CUST_K
    FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT fcd
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON fcd.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
    WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
),
WireTransferCustomers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT fwt.CUST_K
    FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF fwt
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON fwt.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
    WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS distinct_customers
FROM DisputingCustomers dc
LEFT JOIN WireTransferCustomers wtc ON dc.CUST_K = wtc.CUST_K
WHERE wtc.CUST_K IS NULL;

WITH date_keys AS (
    SELECT
        MAX(CASE WHEN CAL_DT = '2024-06-30' THEN DT_K END) AS dt_2024_06_30,
        MAX(CASE WHEN CAL_DT = '2025-06-30' THEN DT_K END) AS dt_2025_06_30
    FROM bank_dwh.D_DT
),
loans_2024 AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT LN_ID
    FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DSBRS, date_keys
    WHERE BUS_DT_K = date_keys.dt_2024_06_30
      AND DYS_PST_DUE = 0
),
loans_2025 AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT LN_ID
    FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DSBRS, date_keys
    WHERE BUS_DT_K = date_keys.dt_2025_06_30
      AND DYS_PST_DUE > 30
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS loans_count
FROM loans_2024
INNER JOIN loans_2025 USING (LN_ID);

WITH transfers_2025 AS (
  SELECT
    f.CCY_CD1 AS currency_code,
    f.STLM_AMT AS amount
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    AND f.STLM_AMT IS NOT NULL
), ranked_transfers AS (
  SELECT
    currency_code,
    amount,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY currency_code ORDER BY amount) AS rn_asc,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY currency_code ORDER BY amount DESC) AS rn_desc,
    COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY currency_code) AS cnt
  FROM transfers_2025
)
SELECT
  currency_code,
  CASE
    WHEN cnt % 2 = 1 THEN
      -- Odd count: median is the middle value
      MAX(CASE WHEN rn_asc = (cnt + 1) / 2 THEN amount END)
    ELSE
      -- Even count: median is average of two middle values
      AVG(CASE WHEN rn_asc IN (cnt / 2, cnt / 2 + 1) THEN amount END)
  END AS median_wire_transfer_amount
FROM ranked_transfers
GROUP BY currency_code
ORDER BY currency_code;

WITH last_snapshots AS (
  SELECT
    dt.MTH_NBR,
    MAX(fac.BUS_DT_K) AS last_bus_dt_k
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D fac
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON fac.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
  WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  GROUP BY dt.MTH_NBR
)
SELECT
  ls.MTH_NBR AS month_number,
  SUM(fac.CLSNG_BAL_AMT) AS total_closing_balance
FROM last_snapshots ls
JOIN bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D fac ON fac.BUS_DT_K = ls.last_bus_dt_k
GROUP BY ls.MTH_NBR
ORDER BY ls.MTH_NBR;

SELECT CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS customer_segment, COUNT(DISTINCT CUST_K) AS customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
WHERE '2023-06-30' BETWEEN EFF_FRM_DT AND EFF_TO_DT
GROUP BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1
ORDER BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1;

WITH WireTransfers2025 AS (
    SELECT
        f.CUST_K,
        SUM(COALESCE(f.STLM_AMT, 0)) AS total_wire_amount
    FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    GROUP BY f.CUST_K
),
RankedCustomers AS (
    SELECT
        wt.CUST_K,
        wt.total_wire_amount,
        c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS segment_code,
        c.BUS_ID AS business_id,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 ORDER BY wt.total_wire_amount DESC) AS rn
    FROM WireTransfers2025 wt
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON wt.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
    WHERE c.IS_CURR = TRUE
)
SELECT
    segment_code,
    business_id,
    total_wire_amount
FROM RankedCustomers
WHERE rn <= 3
ORDER BY segment_code, total_wire_amount DESC;

WITH transfers_2025 AS (
    SELECT CCY_CD1 AS currency_code
    FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
),
counts AS (
    SELECT currency_code, COUNT(*) AS transfer_count
    FROM transfers_2025
    GROUP BY currency_code
),
total AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_count
    FROM transfers_2025
)
SELECT
    c.currency_code,
    ROUND(100.0 * c.transfer_count / NULLIF(t.total_count, 0), 2) AS percentage_of_total
FROM counts c
CROSS JOIN total t
ORDER BY percentage_of_total DESC;

WITH months_2025 AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT MTH_NBR
    FROM bank_dwh.D_DT
    WHERE CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
),
wr_trf_counts AS (
    SELECT dt.MTH_NBR, COUNT(*) AS transfers_in_month
    FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF wr
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON wr.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
    WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    GROUP BY dt.MTH_NBR
),
running_totals AS (
    SELECT m.MTH_NBR,
           COALESCE(SUM(w.transfers_in_month) OVER (ORDER BY m.MTH_NBR ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 0) AS running_total
    FROM months_2025 m
    LEFT JOIN wr_trf_counts w ON m.MTH_NBR = w.MTH_NBR
)
SELECT m.MTH_NBR,
       COALESCE(w.transfers_in_month, 0) AS transfers_in_month,
       r.running_total
FROM months_2025 m
LEFT JOIN wr_trf_counts w ON m.MTH_NBR = w.MTH_NBR
JOIN running_totals r ON m.MTH_NBR = r.MTH_NBR
ORDER BY m.MTH_NBR;

WITH transfers_2025 AS (
    SELECT
        wr_trf.WR_TRF_F_K,
        wr_trf.BUS_DT_K,
        wr_trf.AMT::NUMERIC AS amt,
        wr_trf.CCY_CD1 AS ccy_code
    FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF wr_trf
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON wr_trf.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
    WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
), fx_rates AS (
    SELECT
        fx.BUS_DT_K,
        fx.CCY_CD1 AS ccy_code,
        fx.MID_RT
    FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D fx
    WHERE fx.QUOT_CCY_CD1 = 'EUR'
      AND fx.RT_TYP_CD1 = 'MID'
), transfers_with_fx AS (
    SELECT
        t.amt,
        t.ccy_code,

WITH target_date AS (
    SELECT DT_K FROM bank_dwh.D_DT WHERE CAL_DT = '2025-12-31'
),
-- Sum of disbursed principal up to and including target date
sum_disbursed AS (
    SELECT LN_PRD_K, SUM(PRNCP_AMT) AS total_disbursed
    FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DSBRS
    WHERE BUS_DT_K <= (SELECT DT_K FROM target_date)
    GROUP BY LN_PRD_K
),
-- Sum of principal repaid up to and including target date
sum_repaid AS (
    SELECT LN_PRD_K, SUM(PRNCP_PAID_AMT) AS total_repaid
    FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_RPMT
    WHERE BUS_DT_K <= (SELECT DT_K FROM target_date)

),
outstanding_per_product AS (
    SELECT
        d.LN_PRD_K,
        d.DSPLY_NM AS loan_product_name,
        COALESCE(sd.total_disbursed, 0) - COALESCE(sr.total_repaid, 0) AS total_outstanding_principal
    FROM bank_dwh.D_LN_PRD d
    LEFT JOIN sum_disbursed sd ON d.LN_PRD_K = sd.LN_PRD_K
    LEFT JOIN sum_repaid sr ON d.LN_PRD_K = sr.LN_PRD_K
    WHERE d.IS_CURR = TRUE
)
SELECT loan_product_name, total_outstanding_principal
FROM outstanding_per_product

WITH transfers_2025 AS (
    SELECT
        f.CCY_CD1 AS currency_code,
        CAST(f.STLM_AMT AS NUMERIC) AS amount
    FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
      AND f.STLM_AMT IS NOT NULL
), ranked_transfers AS (
    SELECT
        currency_code,
        amount,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY currency_code ORDER BY amount) AS rn_asc,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY currency_code ORDER BY amount DESC) AS rn_desc,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY currency_code) AS cnt
    FROM transfers_2025
)
SELECT
    currency_code,
    CASE
        WHEN cnt % 2 = 1 THEN
            -- Odd count: median is the middle value
            (SELECT amount FROM ranked_transfers rt2
             WHERE rt2.currency_code = rt.currency_code
               AND rt2.rn_asc = (cnt + 1) / 2
             LIMIT 1)
        ELSE
            -- Even count: median is average of two middle values
            ((SELECT amount FROM ranked_transfers rt2
              WHERE rt2.currency_code = rt.currency_code
                AND rt2.rn_asc = cnt / 2
              LIMIT 1)
             +
             (SELECT amount FROM ranked_transfers rt2
              WHERE rt2.currency_code = rt.currency_code
                AND rt2.rn_asc = cnt / 2 + 1
              LIMIT 1)) / 2
    END AS median_wire_transfer_amount
FROM ranked_transfers rt
GROUP BY currency_code, cnt
ORDER BY currency_code;

WITH transfers_2025 AS (
    SELECT CCY_CD1 AS currency_code, COUNT(*) AS transfer_count

    WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    GROUP BY CCY_CD1
), total_transfers AS (
    SELECT SUM(transfer_count) AS total_count
    FROM transfers_2025
)
SELECT 
    t.currency_code,
    ROUND(100.0 * t.transfer_count / NULLIF(tt.total_count, 0), 2) AS share_percentage
FROM transfers_2025 t

WITH monthly_counts AS (
  SELECT
    dt.MTH_NBR AS month_number,
    COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_count
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF wr

  WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  GROUP BY dt.MTH_NBR
  ORDER BY dt.MTH_NBR
), running_totals AS (
  SELECT
    month_number,
    wire_transfer_count,
    SUM(wire_transfer_count) OVER (ORDER BY month_number ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_total
  FROM monthly_counts
)
SELECT month_number, wire_transfer_count, running_total
FROM running_totals

WITH transfers_2025 AS (
    SELECT
        wr.BUS_DT_K,
        wr.AMT::NUMERIC AS amt,
        wr.CCY_CD1
    FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF wr
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON wr.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
    WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
), fx_rates AS (
    SELECT
        fx.BUS_DT_K,
        fx.CCY_CD1,
        fx.MID_RT
    FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D fx
    WHERE fx.QUOT_CCY_CD1 = 'EUR'
      AND fx.MID_RT IS NOT NULL
), converted_amounts AS (
    SELECT
        t.BUS_DT_K,
        t.amt,
        t.CCY_CD1,
        CASE
            WHEN t.CCY_CD1 = 'EUR' THEN t.amt
            ELSE t.amt / fx.MID_RT
        END AS amt_in_eur
    FROM transfers_2025 t
    LEFT JOIN fx_rates fx ON t.BUS_DT_K = fx.BUS_DT_K AND t.CCY_CD1 = fx.CCY_CD1
    WHERE t.CCY_CD1 = 'EUR' OR fx.MID_RT IS NOT NULL

FROM converted_amounts;

WITH target_date AS (
    SELECT DT_K FROM bank_dwh.D_DT WHERE CAL_DT = '2025-12-31'
),
-- Get the latest disbursement principal amount per loan and product on or before target date
latest_disb AS (
    SELECT
        d.LN_PRD_K,
        d.LN_ID,
        d.BUS_DT_K,
        d.OTSTN_PRNCP_AMT,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.LN_ID ORDER BY d.BUS_DT_K DESC) AS rn
    FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DSBRS d
    JOIN target_date t ON d.BUS_DT_K <= t.DT_K
),
-- Get the latest repayment principal amount per loan and product on or before target date
latest_rpmt AS (
    SELECT
        r.LN_PRD_K,
        r.LN_ID,
        r.BUS_DT_K,
        r.OTSTN_PRNCP_AMT,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.LN_ID ORDER BY r.BUS_DT_K DESC) AS rn
    FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_RPMT r
    JOIN target_date t ON r.BUS_DT_K <= t.DT_K
),
-- Combine disbursement and repayment outstanding principal amounts, prefer repayment if exists
latest_outstanding AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(r.LN_PRD_K, d.LN_PRD_K) AS LN_PRD_K,
        COALESCE(r.LN_ID, d.LN_ID) AS LN_ID,
        CASE
            WHEN r.OTSTN_PRNCP_AMT IS NOT NULL THEN r.OTSTN_PRNCP_AMT
            ELSE d.OTSTN_PRNCP_AMT
        END AS OTSTN_PRNCP_AMT
    FROM latest_disb d
    LEFT JOIN latest_rpmt r ON d.LN_ID = r.LN_ID AND r.rn = 1
    WHERE d.rn = 1
    UNION
    -- Include repayments for loans without disbursement records
    SELECT
        r.LN_PRD_K,
        r.LN_ID,
        r.OTSTN_PRNCP_AMT
    FROM latest_rpmt r
    LEFT JOIN latest_disb d ON r.LN_ID = d.LN_ID
    WHERE r.rn = 1 AND d.LN_ID IS NULL
)
SELECT
    p.DSPLY_NM AS loan_product_name,
    SUM(lo.OTSTN_PRNCP_AMT) AS total_outstanding_principal
FROM latest_outstanding lo
JOIN bank_dwh.D_LN_PRD p ON lo.LN_PRD_K = p.LN_PRD_K
GROUP BY p.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY p.DSPLY_NM;

WITH date_keys AS (

    FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D
    WHERE BUS_DT_K IN ((SELECT dt_k_jun_30 FROM date_keys), (SELECT dt_k_dec_31 FROM date_keys))

balances_pivot AS (

),
loans_20250630 AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT LN_ID
    FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DSBRS, date_keys
    WHERE BUS_DT_K = dt_k_20250630
      AND DYS_PST_DUE > 30
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS loans_count
FROM loans_20240630 l24
JOIN loans_20250630 l25 ON l24.LN_ID = l25.LN_ID;

WITH transfers_2025 AS (
    SELECT
        f.CCY_CD1 AS currency_code,
        CAST(f.STLM_AMT AS NUMERIC) AS amount
    FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
      AND f.STLM_AMT IS NOT NULL
      AND f.CCY_CD1 IS NOT NULL
), ranked_transfers AS (
    SELECT
        currency_code,
        amount,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY currency_code ORDER BY amount) AS rn_asc,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY currency_code ORDER BY amount DESC) AS rn_desc,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY currency_code) AS cnt
    FROM transfers_2025
)
SELECT
    currency_code,
    CASE
        WHEN cnt % 2 = 1 THEN
            -- Odd count: median is the middle value
            (SELECT amount FROM ranked_transfers rt2
             WHERE rt2.currency_code = rt.currency_code
               AND rt2.rn_asc = (cnt + 1) / 2
             LIMIT 1)
        ELSE
            -- Even count: median is average of two middle values
            ((SELECT amount FROM ranked_transfers rt2
              WHERE rt2.currency_code = rt.currency_code
                AND rt2.rn_asc = cnt / 2
              LIMIT 1) +
             (SELECT amount FROM ranked_transfers rt2
              WHERE rt2.currency_code = rt.currency_code
                AND rt2.rn_asc = cnt / 2 + 1
              LIMIT 1)) / 2
    END AS median_wire_transfer_amount
FROM ranked_transfers rt
GROUP BY currency_code, cnt
ORDER BY currency_code;

WITH last_snapshots AS (
  SELECT
    dt.MTH_NBR,
    MAX(fac.BUS_DT_K) AS last_bus_dt_k
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D fac
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON fac.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
  WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  GROUP BY dt.MTH_NBR
),
monthly_closing_bal AS (
  SELECT
    ls.MTH_NBR,
    SUM(fac.CLSNG_BAL_AMT) AS total_closing_balance
  FROM last_snapshots ls
  JOIN bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D fac ON fac.BUS_DT_K = ls.last_bus_dt_k
  GROUP BY ls.MTH_NBR
)
SELECT MTH_NBR, total_closing_balance
FROM monthly_closing_bal
ORDER BY MTH_NBR;

WITH WireTransfers2025 AS (
    SELECT
        f.CUST_K,
        SUM(f.STLM_AMT) AS total_wire_amount
    FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    GROUP BY f.CUST_K
),
RankedCustomers AS (
    SELECT
        wt.CUST_K,
        wt.total_wire_amount,
        c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS segment_code,
        c.BUS_ID AS business_id,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 ORDER BY wt.total_wire_amount DESC) AS rn
    FROM WireTransfers2025 wt
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON wt.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
    WHERE c.IS_CURR = TRUE
)
SELECT
    segment_code,
    business_id,
    total_wire_amount
FROM RankedCustomers
WHERE rn <= 3
ORDER BY segment_code, total_wire_amount DESC;

WITH transfers_2025 AS (
    SELECT CCY_CD1 AS currency_code
    FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
),
counts AS (
    SELECT currency_code, COUNT(*) AS currency_count
    FROM transfers_2025
    GROUP BY currency_code
),
total AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_count
    FROM transfers_2025
)
SELECT
    c.currency_code,
    ROUND(100.0 * c.currency_count / NULLIF(t.total_count, 0), 2) AS percentage_of_total
FROM counts c CROSS JOIN total t
ORDER BY percentage_of_total DESC;

WITH months_2025 AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT MTH_NBR
    FROM bank_dwh.D_DT
    WHERE CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
),
monthly_counts AS (
    SELECT
        dt.MTH_NBR,
        COUNT(f.WR_TRF_F_K) AS wire_transfer_count
    FROM bank_dwh.D_DT dt
    LEFT JOIN bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
    WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    GROUP BY dt.MTH_NBR
),
running_totals AS (
    SELECT
        m.MTH_NBR,
        COALESCE(mc.wire_transfer_count, 0) AS wire_transfer_count,
        SUM(COALESCE(mc.wire_transfer_count, 0)) OVER (ORDER BY m.MTH_NBR ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_total
    FROM months_2025 m
    LEFT JOIN monthly_counts mc ON m.MTH_NBR = mc.MTH_NBR
)
SELECT MTH_NBR, wire_transfer_count, running_total
FROM running_totals
ORDER BY MTH_NBR;

WITH transfers_2025 AS (
    SELECT
        wr.BUS_DT_K,
        wr.AMT::NUMERIC AS amt,
        wr.CCY_CD1
    FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF wr
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON wr.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
    WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
), fx_rates AS (
    SELECT
        fx.BUS_DT_K,
        fx.CCY_CD1,
        fx.MID_RT
    FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D fx
    WHERE fx.QUOT_CCY_CD1 = 'EUR'
      AND fx.RT_TYP_CD1 = 'MID'
), converted_amounts AS (
    SELECT
        t.BUS_DT_K,
        t.amt,
        t.CCY_CD1,
        CASE
            WHEN t.CCY_CD1 = 'EUR' THEN t.amt
            ELSE t.amt / fx.MID_RT
        END AS amt_in_eur
    FROM transfers_2025 t
    LEFT JOIN fx_rates fx ON t.BUS_DT_K = fx.BUS_DT_K AND t.CCY_CD1 = fx.CCY_CD1
    WHERE t.CCY_CD1 = 'EUR' OR fx.MID_RT IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amt_in_eur), 0) AS total_wire_transfer_amount_eur
FROM converted_amounts;

WITH auth_counts AS (
    SELECT
        dt.MTH_NBR,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE fcd.AUTH_RSLT_CD1 = 'DECLINED') AS declined_count,
        COUNT(*) AS total_count
    FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_FEE fcd
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON fcd.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
    WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    GROUP BY dt.MTH_NBR
), declined_shares AS (
    SELECT
        MTH_NBR,
        CASE WHEN total_count > 0 THEN (declined_count::numeric / total_count) * 100 ELSE 0 END AS declined_share_pct
    FROM auth_counts
)
SELECT MTH_NBR, declined_share_pct
FROM declined_shares
ORDER BY declined_share_pct DESC
LIMIT 1;
